# DasNerdwork.net

> Personal homepage and self-hosted service hub of Florian Falk, a full-stack developer from northern Germany. The site is a deliberately framework-free, performance-optimized one-pager showing live price data (heating oil, petrol, Bitcoin, ETFs) and real-time status of all self-hosted services, backed by a public FastAPI REST API.

Key facts:

- The frontend uses no JavaScript framework, only TailwindCSS, Flowbite components and ApexCharts, optimized for a perfect Lighthouse score.
- All price and status data comes from the public REST API at https://api.dasnerdwork.net (FastAPI + PostgreSQL, JSON responses).
- Petrol prices follow the German "12-Uhr-Regel" (since April 2026 stations may raise prices only once daily at noon): the API stores a pre-noon low and post-noon high per day and offers a live endpoint.
- All services run self-hosted on a Debian server administered by the site owner.

## API

- [API documentation (Swagger UI)](https://api.dasnerdwork.net/docs): Interactive documentation of all endpoints
- [Live petrol prices](https://api.dasnerdwork.net/v1/petrol/current): Current E5/E10/diesel prices, 15 min server cache
- [Heating oil history](https://api.dasnerdwork.net/v1/oil?last=30): Daily heating oil prices per 100 L, up to 90 days
- [Bitcoin history](https://api.dasnerdwork.net/v1/btc?last=30): Daily BTC price in EUR, up to 90 days
- [ETF history](https://api.dasnerdwork.net/v1/etfs/spdr?last=90): Daily prices for SPDR MSCI World; also /vaneck and /xtrackers
- [Service status](https://api.dasnerdwork.net/v1/status): Live health checks (HTTP + TCP) of all hosted services

## Projects

- [Frontend source code](https://github.com/DasNerdwork/ultra-fast-homepage): GitHub repository of this one-pager
- [VoidWatcher](https://voidwatch.dasnerdwork.net): Warframe market tracker (FastAPI, PostgreSQL, React/TypeScript)
- [ClashScout](https://clashscout.com): League of Legends Clash analysis platform (PHP, MongoDB, WebSockets)
- [Repo Browser](https://github-repo-browsing.netlify.app): GitHub repository browsing tool
